item.title: Turkey Announces Live-Fire Naval Exercises in Northern Aegean Waters Between Lemnos and Lesvos Amid Ongoing Tensions
item.description: Turkey announces live-fire naval drills in the maritime area between Greek islands Lemnos and Lesvos on February 25, 2026, via NAVTEX, drawing Greek accusations of illegality amid ongoing Aegean tensions and recent diplomatic talks. The post Turkey Announces Live-Fire Naval Exercises in Northern Aegean Waters Between Lemnos and Lesvos Amid Ongoing Tensions appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Protesters Rally Against U.S. Carrier Docking on Crete as Iran Crisis Escalates
item.description: The USS Gerald R. Ford, the world's largest aircraft carrier, has sparked protests on the Greek island of Crete after docking at the U.S. naval base in Souda Bay amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions. The post Protesters Rally Against U.S. Carrier Docking on Crete as Iran Crisis Escalates appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Greece Adopts New Migration Law 2026: Stricter Penalties for Facilitating Irregular Entry
item.description: Greece's February 2026 migration legislation introduces minimum 10-year sentences and heavy fines for assisting irregular migrants, with aggravated penalties for NGO members, amid government efforts to combat smuggling and promote legal pathways. The post Greece Adopts New Migration Law 2026: Stricter Penalties for Facilitating Irregular Entry appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Kyriakos Mitsotakis to Visit Australia for Greek Independence Day Celebrations
item.description: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis will visit Australia on March 25, with stops in Melbourne, Sydney and Canberra for Greek Independence Day celebrations. The post Kyriakos Mitsotakis to Visit Australia for Greek Independence Day Celebrations appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Greek Festival Sydney 2026 Kicks Off at Darling Harbour
item.description: The Greek Festival Sydney 2026 opens at Darling Harbour on March 1 with free performances, food stalls, and family activities celebrating Greek heritage. The post Greek Festival Sydney 2026 Kicks Off at Darling Harbour appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Turkish F-16 Fighter Jet Crashes During Training Flight in Balıkesir: Pilot Killed
item.description: A Turkish Air Force F-16 fighter jet crashed near Balıkesir during a mission flight on February 25, 2026, killing the pilot. The Ministry of National Defence and Governor İsmail Ustaoğlu confirmed the loss, with an investigation underway by the Balıkesir Public Prosecutor's Office. The post Turkish F-16 Fighter Jet Crashes During Training Flight in Balıkesir: Pilot Killed appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Historic Greek Orthodox Church in Adana Reborn as Public Library Draws Over 65,000 Visitors
item.description: The historic Agios Nikolaos Greek Orthodox Church in Adana, built in 1845, has been repurposed as a public library after the 2023 earthquakes, drawing more than 65,000 visitors in 16 months and preserving a key piece of Hellenic heritage in Türkiye. The post Historic Greek Orthodox Church in Adana Reborn as Public Library Draws Over 65,000 Visitors appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Turkey Tightens Trade Restrictions on Israel by Halting EUR-MED Certificates
item.description: Turkey stops issuing EUR-MED preference certificates for exports to Israel via third countries, closing a loophole in its 2024 trade ban and raising costs for Israeli importers in automotive and construction sectors. The post Turkey Tightens Trade Restrictions on Israel by Halting EUR-MED Certificates appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: Greece Plans Strict Social Media Ban for Under-15s Using Kids Wallet App – Challenges Ahead
item.description: Greece is set to ban social media for children under 15 via the Kids Wallet app, with no parental opt-out. Enforcement hurdles and legal issues loom as announcement delayed to Feb 26, 2026. The post Greece Plans Strict Social Media Ban for Under-15s Using Kids Wallet App – Challenges Ahead appeared first on Greek City Times.

item.title: President Tassoulas Attends 113th Anniversary of Konitsa's Liberation from Ottoman Rule
item.description: Greek President Constantine Tassoulas participated in ceremonies for the 113th anniversary of Konitsa's liberation on February 24, 2026, including a Doxology, wreath-laying, and being named honorary citizen of the border town in Epirus. The post President Tassoulas Attends 113th Anniversary of Konitsa's Liberation from Ottoman Rule appeared first on Greek City Times.
